categoryNotes.LOAN_APP: Do not classify all loan apps as malware. Verify the provider/app against Bank of Thailand licensed-provider records. No unverified loan package IDs are added.
categoryNotes.SLOT_GAMBLING: A gambling category is not itself proof of malware or illegality. Add package IDs only when independently verified.
categoryNotes.OVERLAY: No package IDs are pre-approved in this initial allowlist. Populate only after the device owner reviews the app.
categoryNotes.MALWARE_TROJAN: No generic package-name guesses are included. Use exact APK hashes/signatures and corroborating behavior for confirmed detections.
